requested_by: Omri, 2026-09-24: instead of adding channels by family, add the WEAK channels whose hits and errors are independent of entropy (the SML conditional-independence premise)
question: Do weak, entropy-independent channels raise bank11 CONT L-SML on PRMBench, and does L-SML keep its edge over averaging on the enlarged bank?
pool: every step channel materialized for the full population at Top10 readout: the 11-channel bank, CT7's seven token streams, four shape readouts of q15_H1 (profiles_full), the Mind-the-Gap flux, and the 29-stream historical token bank of localization_full_benchmark_v3 (rolling spectral / STFT / permutation entropy / Hurst / CUSUM / sliding-variance views of the entropy, surprisal and energy series, plus topk Renyi2 and tail mass); aligned to the roster with token-count and step-span asserts; 52 columns
selection_rule_label_free: candidate = not in bank11 AND |Pearson r with the level virtual| < 0.35 on PRMBench steps AND max |r| with any bank11 channel < 0.8 AND non-constant; level virtual = mean of the answer-standardized q15_H1, q15_VE1, logprob_margin, true_tail50, energy_level. No label enters the selection. The rule is applied once on the full PRMBench step population (a selection-scope deviation from per-fold discovery, declared).

orientation.problem: a channel independent of entropy has no label-free anchor: the project's anchor rule (sign of the correlation with q15_H1) is a coin flip when that correlation is ~0
orientation.arm_lf: each IND channel multiplied by the sign of its correlation with the level virtual (label-free; the deployable rule)
orientation.arm_oracle: each IND channel multiplied by the sign that makes its single-stream within-AUC >= 0.5 (LABEL-USING ceiling diagnostic, reported separately, never a candidate)

banks.B11_IND_lf: B11 + the 21 IND channels, label-free orientation (32 columns)
banks.B11_IND_or: B11 + the same 21 with oracle orientation (32 columns; diagnostic)

recipe_frozen_from_codex: identical to bank20_lsml_prmbench_v1: Top10 readout, answer-local z, CONT L-SML (lsml_continuous method='residual', automatic K, small_m_guard=True) with anchor q15_H1, L1-normalized weights; controls equal (1/m) and learned-partition group equal (1/(K|g|)); code imported unchanged from .worktrees/depth-feature-fusion-v1
splits: source_groups_v2, five outer folds; eval fold k, calibration (k+1) mod 5 for the q80 threshold only, fit on the other three folds (Codex R0-B); fit rows = all steps of the fit folds' answers, PB+PRMB pooled; B11 fit-on-4 replay asserted against the saved baseline scores at 1e-9
secondary: B11_IND_or_lsml - B11_lsml and - B11_IND_or_equal (the orientation ceiling)
B11_IND_or_lsml - B11_IND_lf_lsml (what orientation alone is worth)
per-fold K, groups, weights, IPR; the total weight L-SML puts on the IND block
single-stream within-AUC and the two orientation signs per IND channel
predictions_frozen: P2 L-SML beats equal on both enlarged banks (weak channels dilute an average more than a learned weight)
P3 label-free orientation agrees with oracle on fewer than 15 of the 21 channels
P4 B11_IND_or_lsml - B11_lsml is within +-0.005 (independence without signal does not add up to much under L-SML)
labels: v3 (evaluation and the oracle-orientation diagnostic only)
interpretation: The SML premise is conditional independence GIVEN correct orientation. If even the oracle-oriented bank does not lift L-SML, weak independent channels do not carry enough signal to matter. If oracle lifts and label-free does not, the bottleneck is orienting entropy-independent channels without labels, which is a specific problem to solve next, not a fusion failure.
